text:
michelle.j: Heads up 1 1 1 we just approved a promotion for an engineer in Ireland with an effective date of Feb 1. The signed packet landed after payroll cutoff last night. Do we run retro on the next payroll or request an off-cycle?
leah.p: @michelle.j usually next payroll unless vendor needs an ad-hoc. Did manager include the manager's-manager sign-off on the packet?
jamal: For EMEA, policy is: if backdate <= 90 days, include on next scheduled run. If > 90 days or if local tax adjustments are needed, we do an off-cycle at payroll vendor discretion. Also confirm employee tax code and PPS number for Ireland.
people-ops: Quick guidance: run retro on the next scheduled payroll unless one of the following is true: backdate > 90 days, payroll vendor (ADP/Local) requires separate run, or compensation change affects equity/bonus pay components that require comp-ops review. For Ireland specifically, payroll vendor requires updated PRSI/USC data if any tax status changed.
people-ops: What payroll needs from the HR intake: 1) signed promo packet PDF + link to Lattice evidence; 2) confirmation of manager and manager's manager approvals (timestamps); 3) country (Ireland), new band/level and effective/backdate window; 4) employee payroll ID and PPS number (if available); 5) note whether backdate > 90 days or if equity/bonus targets changed.
michelle.j: If I email payroll@ with all of that, will they pick it up for the next run? What subject line should I use so it doesn't get missed?
payroll-bot: payroll-bot: Reminder 1 payroll intake cuts off 24 hours prior to run. Anything after cutoff goes to the next run. Use subject: "Retro Request: [LastName, FirstName] 1 [Country]" and attach the signed packet + Lattice link. Include "BACKDATE" in the subject if > 30 days.
leah.p: And fyi, if promo changes target equity grant size or triggers a refresh, loop in comp-ops before submitting to payroll. That avoids rework on payroll side.
michelle.j: Got it. I'll confirm PPS number and manager's manager signoff then send the email with subject "Retro Request: O'Sullivan, Maeve 1 Ireland". Thanks all :thumbsup:
